verdict.rationale: Cactus exposes a hosted, key-based API for data generation, fine-tuning and billing, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question. The evidence documents no sandbox environment, test keys or test mode isolated from production. The available material covers adjacent options only: local open-source fine-tuning, a local eval script that mirrors platform scoring, no-key read endpoints and a browser demo, none of which is a sandbox for the platform.
